description:
A multi-platform proxy client based on Clash Meta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.


Features
- connections Merged requests and connections; quick edit lists
- ui iOS 27 transitions, press and text selection; smoother pages
- update Download and install updates in the app
- core One delay test timeout; VPN crash and startup fixes
Bug Fixes
- core Auto-select leaves an unusable first node at once
- access Keep selections a filter hides
